dialogues.jp:
地べたに座り壁に背を預けて、じっと時計を見
つめる。
dialogues.en:
I sat on the floor leaning against the wall, staring at the
clock.
dialogues.text:
I sat on the floor leaning against the wall, staring at the
clock.

dialogues.jp:
その時計の先の、俺のベッドで眠る音夢を見つ
める。
dialogues.en:
Then I stared at Nemu who was sleeping on my bed beyond the
clock.
dialogues.text:
Then I stared at Nemu who was sleeping on my bed beyond the
clock.

dialogues.jp:
一昨日から音夢を診に来た医者や、美春やこと
り達と人に囲まれ続けていたのだが。
dialogues.en:
For the last two days, I'd been surrounded by the doctor who
came to check Nemu, Miharu, Kotori and all the other guys.
dialogues.text:
For the last two days, I'd been surrounded by the doctor who
came to check Nemu, Miharu, Kotori and all the other guys.

dialogues.jp: 忙しさも退き、ようやく人心地ついた。
dialogues.en:
It seemed everything has settled down and I felt like myself
again.
dialogues.text:
It seemed everything has settled down and I felt like myself
again.

dialogues.jp:
そして、音夢の本校進学を止める通知もまた、
その騒ぎの合間にそっと郵便受けに入っていた。
dialogues.en:
And in the middle of that tumult, I found the letter placed
quietly in the mailbox from school which notified Nemu that
the school has denied her return.
dialogues.text:
And in the middle of that tumult, I found the letter placed
quietly in the mailbox from school which notified Nemu that
the school has denied her return.

dialogues.jp: 「疲れた……」
dialogues.en: "I'm so tired......"
dialogues.text: "I'm so tired......"

dialogues.jp:
儀礼的で事務的なだけの紙を放って、天井を見
上げながら顔をなでる。
dialogues.en:
I looked at the ceiling, smoothing my face with my hand,
throwing the businesslike letter away.
dialogues.text:
I looked at the ceiling, smoothing my face with my hand,
throwing the businesslike letter away.

dialogues.jp: 「なんで物臭な俺がこんなに働いているんだ」
dialogues.en: "Why do I have to work this hard?"
dialogues.text: "Why do I have to work this hard?"

dialogues.jp: 誰にともなく呟く。
dialogues.en: I mumbled to nobody.
dialogues.text: I mumbled to nobody.

dialogues.jp:
それは多分、音夢をこんな風にした神様にだろ
う。
dialogues.en: I guess it was to the god who made Nemu like this.
dialogues.text: I guess it was to the god who made Nemu like this.

dialogues.jp: そして、情けない自分への文句だ。
dialogues.en: And just to complain to myself.
dialogues.text: And just to complain to myself.

dialogues.jp: 「腹減ったな」
dialogues.en: "I'm so hungry."
dialogues.text: "I'm so hungry."

dialogues.jp:
和菓子を作って口の中に放り込むが、カロリー
を消費して生み出される食べ物に意味はない。
dialogues.en:
I created a Japanese sweet and threw it in my mouth, but it
was meaningless since I use my own calories to make them.
dialogues.text:
I created a Japanese sweet and threw it in my mouth, but it
was meaningless since I use my own calories to make them.

dialogues.jp:
「と言うか、舌は誤魔化せても、これが消化さ
　れるまでは差し引きでもマイナスだし……」
dialogues.en:
"It taste good, but I'm using more calories until this is
digested."
dialogues.text:
"It taste good, but I'm using more calories until this is
digested."

dialogues.jp:
気が付いたら出前を頼める時間でもなく、コン
ビニか深夜営業のファミレスに駆け込むしかあ
るまい。
dialogues.en:
It was too late to call for a takeaway, and I had to go to
the convenience store or restaurants which are open 24
hours.
dialogues.text:
It was too late to call for a takeaway, and I had to go to
the convenience store or restaurants which are open 24
hours.

dialogues.jp:
――何度もそう思っているのに、音夢の側から
離れられない。
dialogues.en: I kept telling myself that, but I can't leave Nemu alone.
dialogues.text: I kept telling myself that, but I can't leave Nemu alone.

dialogues.jp:
原因不明の眠りは、いつ目が覚めるのか誰にも
分からない。
dialogues.en:
Nobody knows when she's going to wake up from this unknown
sleep.
dialogues.text:
Nobody knows when she's going to wake up from this unknown
sleep.

dialogues.jp:
そして、音夢が起きたときに、どうしても俺は
側に居てやりたかった。
dialogues.en: And I wanted to be her side when she woke up.
dialogues.text: And I wanted to be her side when she woke up.

dialogues.jp: おはよう――と起こしてやりたかった。
dialogues.en: I wanted to tell her good morning.
dialogues.text: I wanted to tell her good morning.

dialogues.jp: 「……決めたから、な」
dialogues.en: "What a pain......"
dialogues.text: "What a pain......"

dialogues.jp: 側にいるって。
dialogues.en:
I guess I should go to sleep now, and call Miharu in the
morning to pick up something to eat.
dialogues.text:
I guess I should go to sleep now, and call Miharu in the
morning to pick up something to eat.

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず、このまま眠って、明日の朝にでも
美春に電話してなにか買ってきてもらうのが一
番だろう。
dialogues.en: But I can't sleep.
dialogues.text: But I can't sleep.

dialogues.jp: それなのに、眠れない。

dialogues.en: Knock knock knock.
dialogues.text: Knock knock knock.

dialogues.jp: ――コンコンコン。
dialogues.en: "I'm in here."
dialogues.text: "I'm in here."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それはそうだよ」
dialogues.en: "Of course you are."
dialogues.text: "Of course you are."

dialogues.jp:
扉を開けてそろりと中を覗きながら、さくらが
笑う。
dialogues.en: Sakura smiled as she opened the door.
dialogues.text: Sakura smiled as she opened the door.

dialogues.jp: 「よぉ」
dialogues.en: "Hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「よぉ」
dialogues.en: "Hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey."

dialogues.jp: お互いに軽く手を振る。
dialogues.en: We waved at each other.
dialogues.text: We waved at each other.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「電気くらいつけなきゃダメだよ」
dialogues.en: "You should turn the lights on."
dialogues.text: "You should turn the lights on."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いいんだよ。今から寝ようとしてたしな」
dialogues.en: "No. I was going to sleep anyway."
dialogues.text: "No. I was going to sleep anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにゃ、寝るってベッドで音夢ちゃん寝てる
　よ」
dialogues.en: "Huh? But Nemu's sleeping on the bed."
dialogues.text: "Huh? But Nemu's sleeping on the bed."

dialogues.jp: 音夢を見ながらさくらが呟く。
dialogues.en: Sakura mumbled as she looked at Nemu.
dialogues.text: Sakura mumbled as she looked at Nemu.

dialogues.jp: 「添い寝するんだよ」
dialogues.en: "I'm going to sleep by her side."
dialogues.text: "I'm going to sleep by her side."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ！？」
dialogues.en: "What??"
dialogues.text: "What??"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……嘘に決まってるだろうが」
dialogues.en: "I'm joking."
dialogues.text: "I'm joking."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "Phew..."
dialogues.text: "Phew..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「でもさ、お兄ちゃん、今なんとなくそれもい
　いかなとか思わなかった？」
dialogues.en: "But didn't you think that's a good idea?"
dialogues.text: "But didn't you think that's a good idea?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんのことだか」
dialogues.en: "I don't know what you're talking about."
dialogues.text: "I don't know what you're talking about."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「その間はなんなの？」
dialogues.en: "Why did it take you so long?"
dialogues.text: "Why did it take you so long?"

dialogues.jp:
ガサガサ、とビニール袋を俺の前に置いて、さ
くらがベッド脇の階段に座る。
dialogues.en:
Sakura sat on the stairs by the bed, putting the plastic bag
in front of me.
dialogues.text:
Sakura sat on the stairs by the bed, putting the plastic bag
in front of me.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだこれ？」
dialogues.en: "What's this?"
dialogues.text: "What's this?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ご飯だよ。お腹空いてるでしょ？」
dialogues.en: "It's a dinner. Aren't you hungry?"
dialogues.text: "It's a dinner. Aren't you hungry?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……よく分かったな」
dialogues.en: "How did you know?"
dialogues.text: "How did you know?"

dialogues.jp:
袋の中には、コンビニのおにぎりやサンドイッ
チがつまっている。
dialogues.en: I found rice balls and sandwiches inside of it.
dialogues.text: I found rice balls and sandwiches inside of it.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そりゃ分かるよ。お兄ちゃんのことだもん」
dialogues.en: "I know everything about you."
dialogues.text: "I know everything about you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「めんどくさがりなくせしてさ、実はどんな時
　でも一生懸命で……」
dialogues.en: "You're so lazy, but then you always give your best......"
dialogues.text: "You're so lazy, but then you always give your best......"

dialogues.jp: 膝を抱えてさくらが微笑む。
dialogues.en: Sakura smiled holding her knees.
dialogues.text: Sakura smiled holding her knees.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「本当に変わってないなぁ」
dialogues.en: "You haven't changed."
dialogues.text: "You haven't changed."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そっか」
dialogues.en: "You think so?"
dialogues.text: "You think so?"

dialogues.jp: 俺が音夢のことを分かるのと同じようなものか。
dialogues.en: Is it like how I know all about Nemu?
dialogues.text: Is it like how I know all about Nemu?

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ボクが戻ってきた場所は、この島じゃなくて、
　お兄ちゃんの側なんだよね」
dialogues.en: "I came back to you, not this island."
dialogues.text: "I came back to you, not this island."

dialogues.jp: 俺は黙って目を閉じた。
dialogues.en: I closed my eyes quietly.
dialogues.text: I closed my eyes quietly.

dialogues.jp: さくらは別にご飯を届けに来たわけじゃない。
dialogues.en: She didn't come over to bring dinner.
dialogues.text: She didn't come over to bring dinner.

dialogues.jp: それは告白なのだろう。
dialogues.en: She came to confess something.
dialogues.text: She came to confess something.

dialogues.jp:
これから始まる、長い長い告白の最初に、その
覚悟としての独り言だったのだろう。
dialogues.en: And she was talking to herself before the long confession.
dialogues.text: And she was talking to herself before the long confession.

dialogues.jp: 「お前のことだって俺は知ってるぞ」
dialogues.en: "I know about you too."
dialogues.text: "I know about you too."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お前だって音夢と変わらないんだよ」
dialogues.en: "You aren't much different than Nemu."
dialogues.text: "You aren't much different than Nemu."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「回りくどくて、結局人の顔色ばっか窺って損
　をするんだ」
dialogues.en:
"You beat around the bush and don't talk straight, and you
care about what other people are thinking about you, and you
take shit from other people."
dialogues.text:
"You beat around the bush and don't talk straight, and you
care about what other people are thinking about you, and you
take shit from other people."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "I guess."
dialogues.text: "I guess."

dialogues.jp: 窓の外で桜の木が揺れていた。
dialogues.en:
Through the window I could see the cherry tree blowing in
the wind.
dialogues.text:
Through the window I could see the cherry tree blowing in
the wind.

dialogues.jp: 花は散る。
dialogues.en: The blossoms fall.
dialogues.text: The blossoms fall.

dialogues.jp:
しかしこの島は、それが夢だと言うように、い
つまでも花が咲いている。
dialogues.en:
But, the blossoms don't die on this island, as if we're in a
dream.
dialogues.text:
But, the blossoms don't die on this island, as if we're in a
dream.

dialogues.jp: ――｛うつしよ／現世｝は夢、夜の夢こそまこと。
dialogues.en: ---- Reality's a dream, a dream at night is reality.
dialogues.text: ---- Reality's a dream, a dream at night is reality.

dialogues.jp: 昔、どこかで聞いた言葉だ。
dialogues.en: I heard that somewhere a long time ago.
dialogues.text: I heard that somewhere a long time ago.

dialogues.jp:
それならば、こんな夢のような空気の中でこそ
真実は語られるべきなのだろう。
dialogues.en:
If that's true, then we should talk about reality in a
dreamlike atmosphere like this.
dialogues.text:
If that's true, then we should talk about reality in a
dreamlike atmosphere like this.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「音夢ちゃんの不調の原因だけど……多分……
　絶対に聞かないほうがいい」
dialogues.en:
"I think you shouldn't ask about the reason for her
sickness......"
dialogues.text:
"I think you shouldn't ask about the reason for her
sickness......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「どうしてだ」
dialogues.en: "Why?"
dialogues.text: "Why?"

dialogues.jp: 詰問はせず、あくまで何気なく言う。
dialogues.en: I try to sound casual, and not desperate.
dialogues.text: I try to sound casual, and not desperate.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それは……説明すると長いし、変な話だから」
dialogues.en: "Well...... It'll be a long story, and it's weird."
dialogues.text: "Well...... It'll be a long story, and it's weird."

dialogues.jp: さくらが言葉をにごす。
dialogues.en: Sakura made it vague.
dialogues.text: Sakura made it vague.

dialogues.jp: ため息をついて首を振る。
dialogues.en: I sighed and shook my head.
dialogues.text: I sighed and shook my head.

dialogues.jp:
もとより、それが話せることならば、さくらは
すでに語っていたのだろう。
dialogues.en:
I guess if she could talk about it, she would have done so
sooner.
dialogues.text:
I guess if she could talk about it, she would have done so
sooner.

dialogues.en:
"What a pain...... then, I guess the cause and the solution
are different."
dialogues.text:
"What a pain...... then, I guess the cause and the solution
are different."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「音夢ちゃんから離れて」
dialogues.en: "You should separate from Nemu-chan."
dialogues.text: "You should separate from Nemu-chan."

dialogues.jp: きっぱり、と断言する。
dialogues.en: She declared.
dialogues.text: She declared.

dialogues.en: "Is it because I'm too much for her, mentally?"
dialogues.text: "Is it because I'm too much for her, mentally?"

dialogues.jp:
いつだったか、音夢が倒れた原因は、心因性の
ものだと言われたのを思い出す。
dialogues.en: "That's not right, but not wrong either."
dialogues.text: "That's not right, but not wrong either."

dialogues.jp:
「俺が音夢にとって精神的な重荷になってるっ
　てことなのか？」
dialogues.en: "Which is it?"
dialogues.text: "Which is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「正しくはないけど、間違ってもいない」
dialogues.en: "Ugh...... It's hard to explain."
dialogues.text: "Ugh...... It's hard to explain."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「どっちやねん」
dialogues.en: "You don't have get too in depth, just the basics."
dialogues.text: "You don't have get too in depth, just the basics."

dialogues.jp: 軽く手を振る。
dialogues.en: I waved lightly.
dialogues.text: I waved lightly.

dialogues.jp:
どうして――の部分は、さくらが納得しなけれ
ば説明されまい。
dialogues.en:
Perhaps, she won't explain it to me until she understands
why I love Nemu.
dialogues.text:
Perhaps, she won't explain it to me until she understands
why I love Nemu.

dialogues.jp: 「具体的に俺はなにをすればいいんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What do I need to do?"
dialogues.text: "What do I need to do?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ぶっちゃけて、音夢ちゃんのこと嫌いになっ
　て欲しい」
dialogues.en: "To be honest, I want you to hate Nemu-chan."
dialogues.text: "To be honest, I want you to hate Nemu-chan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「もしくは、音夢ちゃんがお兄ちゃんのことを
　嫌いになってくれれば……」
dialogues.en: "Or, Nemu-chan can hate you...... either way."
dialogues.text: "Or, Nemu-chan can hate you...... either way."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おい、なんだそりゃ？」
dialogues.en: "What? Why's that?"
dialogues.text: "What? Why's that?"

dialogues.jp:
音夢の不調を直すのに、どうして俺があいつを
嫌いにならなければいけないんだ？
dialogues.en: Why do I have to hate her to heal her bad condition?
dialogues.text: Why do I have to hate her to heal her bad condition?

dialogues.jp:
どこにあるか分からない薬草をとってくるとか、
魔法使いを探してこいと言われるほうが、まだ
状況だけは理解できる。
dialogues.en:
It would be easier to believe her if she told me find a
mystical medicinal herb or a witch.
dialogues.text:
It would be easier to believe her if she told me find a
mystical medicinal herb or a witch.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あぅ、そうだなぁ……身体に悪い影響を与え
　る恋患いというのが一番分かりやすいかな」
dialogues.en:
"Well...... it might be easier to understand if I said that
it's a love sickness which has a bad effect on her
wellbeing."
dialogues.text:
"Well...... it might be easier to understand if I said that
it's a love sickness which has a bad effect on her
wellbeing."

dialogues.jp: あまりにもバカげた話に頭がくらくらする。
dialogues.en: "What? No way."
dialogues.text: "What? No way."

dialogues.jp: だが――。
dialogues.en: This is so unbelievable, it's giving me a headache.
dialogues.text: This is so unbelievable, it's giving me a headache.

dialogues.jp: 初めてのキス。
抱きしめ合った夜。
dialogues.en: Our first kiss.
dialogues.text: Our first kiss.

dialogues.jp:
音夢の異変が｛けんちょ／顕著｝になったのは、やはり俺との
関係が変わり、深まってからだ。
dialogues.en: The night I made love to her.
dialogues.text: The night I made love to her.

dialogues.en:
I realized her condition got worse since our relationship
changed.
dialogues.text:
I realized her condition got worse since our relationship
changed.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「音夢ちゃんは、お兄ちゃんと心でも結ばれて
　るんだ……強く強く」
dialogues.en: "Nemu-chan's strongly connected to you by her feelings."
dialogues.text: "Nemu-chan's strongly connected to you by her feelings."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それが音夢ちゃんの力なんだ」
dialogues.en: "And it's the source of her power."
dialogues.text: "And it's the source of her power."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「音夢ちゃんはお兄ちゃんと心で結ばれてるの。
　ずっと家族以上の家族になりたいって」
dialogues.en:
"Nemu-chan's connected to you by her heart. She wants to
become your real family. She's wishing for that, very
strongly."
dialogues.text:
"Nemu-chan's connected to you by her heart. She wants to
become your real family. She's wishing for that, very
strongly."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃんとしても、ひとりの男の子とし
　ても、もっとずっとお兄ちゃんを知りたく
　て……」
dialogues.en:
"She wants to know you better as a brother and also as a
man......"
dialogues.text:
"She wants to know you better as a brother and also as a
man......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それを音夢ちゃんが願ったから」
dialogues.en: "She wished for that."
dialogues.text: "She wished for that."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「でもそれは、喜びを２倍にするけれど、悲し
　みや苦しみも２倍になるんだよ……」
dialogues.en:
"It makes her happiness twice as good, but it also makes
sadness and hardships hurt twice as much......"
dialogues.text:
"It makes her happiness twice as good, but it also makes
sadness and hardships hurt twice as much......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「心は、身体よりも強いんだよ……ひとりの人
　間がふたり分の心を持つことなんて出来ない
　の」
dialogues.en:
"That feeling's stronger than her body...... it's impossible
to have two different feelings in one body."
dialogues.text:
"That feeling's stronger than her body...... it's impossible
to have two different feelings in one body."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ね、こんな話されても困るでしょ？」
dialogues.en: "See? I told you, you wouldn't understand."
dialogues.text: "See? I told you, you wouldn't understand."

dialogues.jp:
にわかには信じがたい……と言うより、そんな
のほとんど妄想のレベルだ。
dialogues.en:
It's hard to believe just like that. It's almost like a
delusion.
dialogues.text:
It's hard to believe just like that. It's almost like a
delusion.

dialogues.jp:
だが、それを言えば俺の和菓子を作る力も、他
人の夢を見せられる力も大差ない。
dialogues.en:
But, I guess it's a same thing as me having the power to
create Japanese sweets in my hand, or being able to see
other people's dreams.
dialogues.text:
But, I guess it's a same thing as me having the power to
create Japanese sweets in my hand, or being able to see
other people's dreams.

dialogues.jp: それに、
dialogues.en: And,
dialogues.text: And,

dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、なにか？　俺と音夢が仲良くするほ
　どあいつは弱っていくのか？」
dialogues.en:
"So, you're saying she gets worse as we get closer to each
other?"
dialogues.text:
"So, you're saying she gets worse as we get closer to each
other?"

dialogues.jp: こく、とさくらは｛ためら／躊躇｝いもなく頷く。
dialogues.en: Sakura nods immediately.
dialogues.text: Sakura nods immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「女の子の恋心が、どんなに強く胸を打つか知っ
　てる？」
dialogues.en:
"Do you know how hard love hits you, when girls fall in
love?"
dialogues.text:
"Do you know how hard love hits you, when girls fall in
love?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「その喜びは……痛みをともなうんだよ」
dialogues.en: "That happiness comes with pain."
dialogues.text: "That happiness comes with pain."

dialogues.jp: わかる……ような気がする。
dialogues.en: "It's not like a novel or a computer game......"
dialogues.text: "It's not like a novel or a computer game......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「とにかく、お兄ちゃんと音夢ちゃんはこれ以
　上好きになっちゃダメだよ」
dialogues.en: "Anyways, don't go any further with Nemu-chan."
dialogues.text: "Anyways, don't go any further with Nemu-chan."

dialogues.jp:
小さく、俺の様子を窺うようにさくらが呟いて
立ち上がる。
dialogues.en: Sakura mumbled looking at me, and she stood up.
dialogues.text: Sakura mumbled looking at me, and she stood up.

dialogues.jp: 好きになるな。
dialogues.en: I'm not supposed to love her.
dialogues.text: I'm not supposed to love her.

dialogues.jp: それは――もう遅い。
dialogues.en: But, it's too late.
dialogues.text: But, it's too late.

dialogues.jp: 嫌いになる。嫌いにさせる。
dialogues.en: Either I hate her, or make her hate me.
dialogues.text: Either I hate her, or make her hate me.

dialogues.jp: どんな方法で嫌われるのか。
dialogues.en: What can I do to make her hate me?
dialogues.text: What can I do to make her hate me?

dialogues.jp: そんな想像も出来ない。
dialogues.en: I can't even imagine.
dialogues.text: I can't even imagine.

dialogues.jp:
お互いにお互いのことを知りすぎていて、嘘が
嘘になりえない。
dialogues.en: We know each other too well, I can't lie.
dialogues.text: We know each other too well, I can't lie.

dialogues.jp: 「……俺にどうしろってんだ」
dialogues.en: "What am I supposed to do?"
dialogues.text: "What am I supposed to do?"

dialogues.jp: 一緒にいるって言ったんだ。
dialogues.en: Sakura looked down at me as I bit my lips.
dialogues.text: Sakura looked down at me as I bit my lips.

dialogues.jp: 離れないって。
dialogues.en: "Try to avoid her...... there's no other way..."
dialogues.text: "Try to avoid her...... there's no other way..."

dialogues.jp: 二度といわないから忘れるなって。
dialogues.en: And she hugged my head.
dialogues.text: And she hugged my head.

dialogues.en: "If...... if you can't do anything else......"
dialogues.text: "If...... if you can't do anything else......"

dialogues.jp: とことこ、と唇を噛む俺をさくらが見下ろす。

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「出来るだけ避けて……他に方法がないんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Maybe you'll hate me."
dialogues.text: "Maybe you'll hate me."

dialogues.jp: さくらにぎゅっと、頭を抱きしめられる。

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「もし……もし、どうしようもないときは……」
dialogues.en: "Good night."
dialogues.text: "Good night."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Sakura?"
dialogues.text: "Sakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクはお兄ちゃんに嫌われるかな」
dialogues.en: "Do you realize my breasts are touching you?"
dialogues.text: "Do you realize my breasts are touching you?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Wow!?"
dialogues.text: "Wow!?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おやすみ」
dialogues.en: "What a pervert!"
dialogues.text: "What a pervert!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「さくら？」
dialogues.en: "Hey! Let me go!"
dialogues.text: "Hey! Let me go!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にへへ……胸が当たってるの分かる？」
dialogues.en:
I try to push her away, but she shifted smoothly and grabbed
me by my head.
dialogues.text:
I try to push her away, but she shifted smoothly and grabbed
me by my head.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Hey...... can you hear this?"
dialogues.text: "Hey...... can you hear this?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「わー、お兄ちゃんのエッチ〜♪」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「こらっ！　離せったらさくらっ！」
dialogues.en: "The sound of my heartbeat."
dialogues.text: "The sound of my heartbeat."

dialogues.jp:
ぐっ、とさくらを押し出そうとしたのに、さく
らが上手く重心をずらして頭を抱え込む。

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ねぇ……音、聞こえない？」
dialogues.en: I'm not joking but she has no breasts.
dialogues.text: I'm not joking but she has no breasts.

dialogues.jp:
さくらの胸からはハムスターのように落ち着き
のない鼓動が聞こえる。
dialogues.en: I could hear her heart pounding fast like a hamster.
dialogues.text: I could hear her heart pounding fast like a hamster.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「本当に万が一だけどね……万が一でも嫌われ
　るのは……ボクも怖いな」
dialogues.en: "What if...... If you ever hate me? I'm scared as well."
dialogues.text: "What if...... If you ever hate me? I'm scared as well."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「今日だけ……」
dialogues.en: "Just for now......"
dialogues.text: "Just for now......"

dialogues.jp: ぎゅっ、とさくらの腕の力が増す。
dialogues.en: Sakura held me tightly.
dialogues.text: Sakura held me tightly.

dialogues.jp: だが、すぐに離れた。
dialogues.en: But she moved herself away soon.
dialogues.text: But she moved herself away soon.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……ううん。ずるいずるい」
dialogues.en: "No...... This isn't fair."
dialogues.text: "No...... This isn't fair."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Fair?"
dialogues.text: "Fair?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん……いや、お兄ちゃんとボクがくっ付
　けば、万事解決万々歳なんだけどね」
dialogues.en:
"Well...... if we ended up dating, then it'll be the best
result."
dialogues.text:
"Well...... if we ended up dating, then it'll be the best
result."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「しかも、これが最後から２番目のチャンスな
　んだけどなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "And this would be my second to last chance......"
dialogues.text: "And this would be my second to last chance......"

dialogues.jp: さくらが首をかしげて、そしてドアを開ける。
dialogues.en: Sakura tilted her head and opened the door.
dialogues.text: Sakura tilted her head and opened the door.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、どうして？」
dialogues.en: "Then why?"
dialogues.text: "Then why?"

dialogues.jp: 座りながらさくらの横顔を見上げた。
dialogues.en: I looked up at Sakura as I sat on the floor.
dialogues.text: I looked up at Sakura as I sat on the floor.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それは……ボクが恋する女の子の味方だから」
dialogues.en: "Because...... I support girls who are in love."
dialogues.text: "Because...... I support girls who are in love."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「それに、お兄ちゃんの一番のハッピーじゃな
　いでしょ♪」
dialogues.en: "And you wouldn't be happy either."
dialogues.text: "And you wouldn't be happy either."

dialogues.jp: 満面の笑みをさくらが浮かべる。
dialogues.en: Sakura smiled.
dialogues.text: Sakura smiled.

dialogues.jp: 「……どうかな」
dialogues.en: "...We'll see about that."
dialogues.text: "...We'll see about that."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「素直じゃないんだから」
dialogues.en: "You aren't honest."
dialogues.text: "You aren't honest."

dialogues.jp: ドアが閉まる。
dialogues.en: The door closed.
dialogues.text: The door closed.

dialogues.jp: ドアの向こうに声を投げる。
dialogues.en: I talked to her from behind the door.
dialogues.text: I talked to her from behind the door.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: もう、どうしようもないくらい。
dialogues.en: "I love Nemu."
dialogues.text: "I love Nemu."

dialogues.jp: 頭の中は、音夢のことでいっぱいなんだ。
dialogues.en: "I know."
dialogues.text: "I know."

dialogues.jp: 「だからさ――」
だから──。
dialogues.en: "Let's make it a happy ending."
dialogues.text: "Let's make it a happy ending."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おやすみ」
dialogues.en: "Good night."
dialogues.text: "Good night."

dialogues.jp: 答えはなく、足音だけが遠ざかった。
dialogues.en: She didn't answer me, but I heard her footsteps going away.
dialogues.text: She didn't answer me, but I heard her footsteps going away.

dialogues.jp: ◆音夢の病の謎◆
dialogues.en: ◆The mystery of Nemu's condition◆
dialogues.text: ◆The mystery of Nemu's condition◆

dialogues.jp: あれから２日間。音夢は目を覚ましていない。
dialogues.en: It had been two days. Nemu hadn't woken up.
dialogues.text: It had been two days. Nemu hadn't woken up.

dialogues.jp:
片時も離れず看病を続ける俺の元にさくらが現
れる。
dialogues.en: Sakura showed up as I stayed by her side.
dialogues.text: Sakura showed up as I stayed by her side.

dialogues.jp:
そこで俺は、音夢と俺と病気の関係を聞くこと
となる――音夢を助けたければ離れるしかない、
と。
dialogues.en:
Then she told me about the connection between her condition
and our relationship. And if I want to save Nemu, then I
have to leave her.
dialogues.text:
Then she told me about the connection between her condition
and our relationship. And if I want to save Nemu, then I
have to leave her.
